meta.name: paid-ads-launch
meta.description: Plan and prepare a new paid-media campaign or cross-channel test before it can spend. Use when asked to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an advertising campaign on any supported platform.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在花钱之前把新广告投放的方案和各渠道预算规划好
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正准备上线新的付费广告或做跨渠道投放测试
copy.tagline_en: Plan a new paid campaign and its channel budgets before any spend
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to launch a paid ad campaign or cross-channel test

howto.what: 当你要求新建或启动广告投放时,Claude 会先核对转化目标、预算、落地页等前置信息,再产出一份标记为 ready_for_review 的投放前简报,内容涵盖渠道结构、预算、信息链、实验设计与就绪状态。
howto.when: 当你要创建、启动、建立广告活动或为之分配预算时触发,适用于受支持的各投放平台。

say.text: 帮我为新品做一份 Google 搜索广告的投放前简报
say.note: 会先补齐转化目标与预算再出简报

say.text: 我要在 Meta 建一个广告组,先按暂停状态创建
月预算 5000,帮我规划一个 LinkedIn 的小规模测试
say.note: 会建议单一渠道测试并设复盘日期

howto.what_en: When asked to set up or launch a campaign, Claude first gathers required inputs (conversion goal, budget, landing URL, geo) then produces a ready_for_review preflight brief covering channel, budget, message, experiment and readiness.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create, launch, start, set up, or allocate budget to an ad campaign on a supported platform.

say_en.text: Draft a preflight brief for my new Google Search campaign.
say_en.note: It gates on conversion goal and budget first

say_en.text: Set up a Meta ad set, created paused.
Plan a small LinkedIn test with a $5,000 monthly budget.
say_en.note: Suggests one narrow test and a review date
